reviewer: Codex implementation self-review; advisory only, product-owner acceptance required
rationale: B2 satisfies the confirmed TypeScript compatibility boundary and makes Target a stable, authorized, immutable read object without creating a counterfeit native write model. The projection fails closed on ineligible or missing current sources, preserves replay identity, authorizes active reads from current source facts, exposes a stable retryable outage when an active snapshot is missing, and keeps completion separate from Acceptance. The enabled shell now has real Project Target lists and a useful read-only Workbench. Focused tests, migration safety, workspace typecheck, affected-package builds, token and locale gates, API checks, and inspected desktop/mobile evidence pass. The root test baseline and external skills-catalog build blocker remain unrelated and explicitly recorded, so this is ready for product-owner review but not for a global green or ship claim.
conditions: Treat this as advisory approval of the B2 read-only compatibility slice, not permission to commit, merge, enable globally, ship, deploy, or announce.
Keep authoritative Target and TargetRevision commands out of TypeScript; native New Target begins in the Go Domain API.
Make the next architecture goal establish the Go domain kernel, command idempotency and outbox boundary, then connect Temporal without moving business truth into Workflow state.
Keep enableVerrailNavigation controlled until B2 receives product-owner acceptance and the next native Target command path is ready.
Resolve or formally baseline the inherited repository-wide macOS/runtime failures and skills-catalog external-fetch build dependency before claiming a release candidate.
